adminFromSetting.description: An admin because the server's ADMIN_EMAILS lists them, which the web app can't change.

lastActiveAt.description: When one of their devices last used the account; none if never signed in since joining.

invitedBy.description: The name of the admin whose invitation they joined with.

lockedUntil.description: Signing in is refused until then, after too many wrong passwords (SEC-12); Unlock ends it now.

description: An account on this server, as an admin sees it (USR-1).
